notes.title: Happy 3rd Birthday Toodee and Topdee!
notes.content:
Yesterday was 3 years since Toodee and Topdee first released on Steam!!!

I wanted to thank you all for being a part of this journey and making this possible.
Thanks to you I can keep making games as my job :)
Toodee and Topdee is a success story, and it started as a game jam game that me and my brother made in less than 3 days, and we're so proud of how far it has come.
Since then Toodee and Topdee was released on all major platforms, and even had a physical release.
Will there be a sequel? Probably not!
What's next for Toodee and Topdee? Maybe a mobile version, maybe a plushie, would you be interested in that?
The only thing that I can guarantee at the moment is that more discounts are coming! :D

OTHER STUFF FROM ME
If you liked Toodee and Topdee - I'm working on a new puzzle platformer called UVSU- play against yourself, plan ahead and outsmart your past demons. It also started as a jam game so the screenshots that you see are from that, it's looking a lot different now 😈
Add it to your wishlist for updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2513270/UVSU/

BTW did you know that I released another game? It's a short and sweet bite-sized action roguelike called Trouble Juice!
It's really cheap, and it's even cheaper if you have Toodee and Topdee. Also they are usually on a sale together and then it's MAXIMUM CHEAP so make sure to put it in your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2065840/TROUBLE_JUICE/

And lastly- follow my creator page here on Steam to get updated when I release new games and demos.
(I am also planning to release a free game sometime in the near future!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37865064/a753819469f305927774a70b667bd65c041b0ab5.png


THANK YOU!!!

notes.title: Version 1.0.1.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
I've been reading reviews, comments, watching YouTube vids and streams on Twitch, and I've been working on a balance patch, and it is now live!

- Boss fights now have checkpoints! Now if you die, instead of starting from the beginning you will start from the current phase you were in. A lot less frustrating. If you want more challenge [spoiler]or the ladybugs[/spoiler] you can toggle this off in the difficulty menu.
- The second boss, Yumbrozi (the monkey) was a major pain for many, many players. So now horizontal jumps are telegraphed by a sound effect and the eyes shining, and Topdee can dodge the circular smoke effects. This gives you a lot more options! And together with the checkpoints I think this will no longer be such a frustrating experience for many players.
- Some levels that I saw that people struggle with (especially in chapter 2) were changed a little bit, hopefully they are better now.
- Many small bug fixes and performance improvements! Performance wasn't really an issue on semi-modern computers, but if you had an older one and it was lagging, it should be a lot better now!

Let me know if you run into any problems, and I hope you enjoy!

<3

EDIT: saw some streamers play and caught a few mistakes lol
Fixed them now! Newest version is 1.0.1.1

Thanks and as always let me know if you find anything!

notes.title: Looking for play testers for the new patch!
notes.content:
I'm working on an update which will come out in a few days!
It doesn't have any new content, but it fixes a lot of things that many players struggled with.
I also fixed some levels that makes them more fun and less tedious.
And a lot of performance optimizations, so if the game used to lag for you, hopefully it'll be better now!

If you own the game, the patch is now live on the beta branch, which you can check out yourself if you want.
